newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi raises May crude prices by $1.70-$2.00.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi raises May crude prices by $1.70-$2.00.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has raised its May official crude selling prices by $1.70-$2.00 a barrel, a company statement said on Sunday.
Murban was raised by $1.70 to $20.00 a barrel. Lower Zakum and Umm Shaif were raised by the same amount to $20.05 and $19.75 respectively.
Upper Zakum was increased by $2.00 to $18.70.
ADNOC sets its official crude prices each month on a retroactive basis on spot market developments.
